geometry_basis: The preserved Lightology line drawing explicitly dimensions the small option at 11 in projection, 8.5 in overall height, 7.9 in globe diameter and 4.3 in wall-plate diameter. The exact 231180 product image establishes the defining L-shaped brass tube, rounded elbow, shallow bell wall plate, top contact cap and opal globe. Tube thickness, bell-plate depth/profile and globe depth placement are image-derived and remain documented inferences.
orientation_note: The product/application photography shows equivalent rotated wall mounting orientations. The face-based family is built in the line-drawing top-rail orientation and may be rotated on its host face.
